title: Website publishing
description: Publishes a branch to the project website. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#publish

whoami.description: Branch to publish from. Publishing only happens when this matches the current branch.

subdir.description: Subdirectory to publish from. May not contain '../' or start with a forward slash. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#subdir

hostname.description: Hostname override. Must be events.apache.org or a non-ASF hostname unless an override mapping exists. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#nondefault
